principles: Knowledge organization independently qualifies through an actual knowledge-management feature/component organizing reusable facts or documents. Internal data structures, caches and training traces alone are insufficient.
Actual curated entry purposes count even when their implementations are external; only capabilities/owned forms require implementation ownership.
Explicit human educational reference/examples, courses, study/teaching/coaching resources qualify even when optional or secondary.
Ordinary own installation/usage instructions and instructions teaching an agent another business task alone are insufficient.
The documentary verdict is based only on the actual supplied name/description/topics/README prefix. Uninspected links are not expanded; missing/truncated details remain boundaries where material.
Original gold24 and all old outputs remain unchanged; this is prospective complete-dimension annotation, not a rewrite of past pass/fail statistics.
